ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with localized high-intensity (white) anomalies; approximate distribution of 90% low-intensity to 10% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white markings on a uniform black background. Mapping includes an oval cluster on the left lobe, multiple ring-shaped coordinates on the right lobe, and a distinctive '9-shaped' mark on the central right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 135 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire linear boundary; multiple peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels, particularly pronounced on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge, tapering to sharp, elongated distal points on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least 8 distinct circular and ring-like white pixel clusters (rosettes) concentrated on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); high density on the right lobe with several horizontal segments on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive pigmentation disruption consisting of circular barnacle attachment scars and multi-directional linear rake marks across both visible ventral lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique hook-shaped or '9-shaped' white mark located in the right-central fluke region; extremely jagged/irregular distal margin on the right tip.
